pulp.name: --color-text-faint
pulp.description: Lowest-emphasis text. Promised AA on base and raised surfaces only, not on sunken.

pulp.name: --color-text-on-action
pulp.description: Text on an action fill. Dark scheme fills are light, so the text flips to ink.

pulp.name: --color-action-text
pulp.description: Accent for text and icons sitting on a surface (links, ghost buttons). Meets AA on every surface; action.primary is a fill and need not.

pulp.name: --color-status-error-text
pulp.description: Error colour for text (messages, required markers). status.error is a fill/border colour and is below AA as text on light surfaces.

pulp.name: --color-overlay-backdrop
pulp.description: Scrim behind dialogs and sheets. Alpha hex, no primitive: it is a role, not a palette colour.

pulp.name: --space-unit
pulp.description: The density knob. Every semantic space token is a multiple of this.

pulp.name: --typeface-mono
pulp.css: 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace
pulp.value: 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

pulp.name: --font-family-mono
pulp.value: 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

pulp.name: --shadow-overlay
pulp.description: Elevation for floating surfaces: dialogs, popovers.

bitepals.name: --color-text-faint
bitepals.description: Lowest-emphasis text. Promised AA on base and raised surfaces only, not on sunken.

bitepals.name: --color-text-on-action
bitepals.description: Ink, not white: white on the brand orange is 2.8:1 and fails AA in both schemes.

bitepals.name: --color-action-primary-hover
bitepals.description: Interaction brightens rather than darkens: the fill carries ink text, and a darker orange would drop below AA.

bitepals.name: --color-action-text
bitepals.description: Accent for text and icons on a surface. The brand orange itself is 2.3:1 on cream, so text uses the 800 step.

bitepals.name: --color-status-error-text
bitepals.description: Error colour for text (messages, required markers). status.error is a fill/border colour and is below AA as text on light surfaces.

bitepals.name: --color-overlay-backdrop
bitepals.description: Scrim behind dialogs and sheets. Alpha hex, no primitive: it is a role, not a palette colour.

bitepals.name: --space-unit
bitepals.description: Roomier than pulp: the whole spacing scale grows 12% from this one value.

bitepals.name: --shadow-overlay
bitepals.description: Elevation for floating surfaces: dialogs, popovers.
